description: Activate when the user wants to simulate a double-blind peer review of their paper before submission or before sharing with co-authors. Reads the current draft (draft.md or paper.tex), generates 2 independent reviewer reports in the style of top IS/CS conferences (ICIS, ECIS, MISQ level), and saves the output as simulated_reviews.md. The output is formatted to serve as direct input for /respond-reviewers (review-engine feedback loop).
